items.html: What emerges from all this is that there are two kinds of couplings: one in the secret of back to back at first, and afterward face to face, when Adam HaRishon came. And then he corrected only from Yetzira and upward, but Assiya remained back to back, as at first. Therefore, what Adam HaRishon returned face to face — which is Yetzira — accordingly receives from the secret of the first, more choice coupling of face to face. But Assiya, which remained back to back, receives only from the back-to-back coupling of ZON of Atzilut, as they were at the time Adam HaRishon came.
